title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009)

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) as a historical Modern Warfare digital filing.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from curated portrait key art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows and macOS PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title. Multiplayer components may depend on Activision services.
preservation.concerns: Older online multiplayer titles face elevated server and matchmaking risk. Account-bound licensing and the absence of a retained offline installer remain the principal preservation concerns.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam release dated November 11, 2009. This accession records the licensed 2009 Modern Warfare 2 digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

steam.shortDescription: The most-anticipated game of the year and the sequel to the best-selling first-person action game of all time, Modern Warfare 2 continues the gripping and heart-racing action as players face off against a new threat dedicated to bringing the world to the brink of collapse.
